description: Indian Passport (Type P) issued by the Ministry of External Affairs.

field_hints.passport_number: 8-character alphanumeric code starting with a letter, e.g. A1234567. Printed at top right of photo page and in MRZ.
field_hints.surname: Family / last name as printed under 'Surname' label.
field_hints.given_names: All given / first names separated by spaces as printed under 'Given Name(s)' label.
field_hints.date_of_birth: Format DD/MM/YYYY as printed on the passport.
field_hints.date_of_issue: Date the passport was issued. Format DD/MM/YYYY.
field_hints.place_of_birth: City or state of birth as printed.
field_hints.place_of_issue: Passport office city or regional passport office name.
field_hints.gender: M for Male, F for Female.
field_hints.father_name: Father's full name if printed in the booklet.
field_hints.mother_name: Mother's full name if printed in the booklet.
field_hints.address: Permanent residential address if printed on the last page.
